executive_request: Build N5: run the Delphi Oracle Method cycle as a durable Temporal workflow on the existing self-host (localhost:7233, namespace default, task queue delphi-cycle). Wrap, never re-implement, the existing cycle machinery (generate_proposal.py, cross_vote.py, method_cycle.py). Ballots arrive as validated signals; round 2 opens only on a facilitator signal and rejects ballots lacking the equalized evidence bundle sha256. Ledger payloads are emitted exactly once per workflow+stage. Promotion over method_cycle.py requires the dual-run parity proof and the live kill-resume acceptance proof in the brief (§5).

items.text: scripts/temporal/delphi_cycle/{workflow,activities,worker,client}.py: DelphiCycleWorkflow with one activity per cycle stage wrapping the existing scripts/delphi machinery.

BallotSignal validation per cycle v2 (rationale + evidence_refs required; source classes separate; round-2 requires evidence_bundle_sha256; rejections recorded with reasons) + facilitator signal gate before round 2 + CycleStatus query.
Ledger emission activity: title-resolved routes to #1487/#1489, idempotency key = workflow ID + stage, payloads built in-activity, digests only in workflow state.
Worker service: systemd unit mirror under scripts/temporal/selfhost/ + keepalive enrolment.
Tests: tests/test_delphi_cycle.py (determinism, ballot validation, parity shape).

Acceptance proof (brief §5): fixture cycle on self-host, SIGKILL worker mid-implementation-round, second worker completes; wrong-hash round-2 ballot rejected + recorded; ledger payloads exactly once; parity vs method_cycle.py on the same fixture.
